Rename images efficiently and maximize SEO ranking!

Rename your images and videos in a flash and improve your website’s SEO performance. All references are automatically updated across the entire database.

Help & Support

  • neo Rename Free Support: https://neo-wp.com/contact/#free

Get Pro Features

Find out what the Pro version of neo Rename offers to unlock the full potential of your media. ➔ What the Pro version can do

Installation & Activation

Installation via the WordPress Plugin Directory

  • Open the WordPress backend > Plugins > Add New
  • Search for “neo Rename” and click “Install Now”.
  • After installation click “Activate”.

Installation of neo Rename from the official neoWP website

  • Download the Renamer plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Open the WordPress backend > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin > Activate Plugin

Manual installation of neo Rename via FTP

  • Download the Renamer plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Unzip the ZIP file and upload the neo-rename folder via FTP into the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  • Go to the WordPress backend > Plugins > find “neo Rename” in the list and click “Activate”.

After activating the Renamer plugin

  • Click on “neoWP” in the side bar of the WordPress backend to review and adjust the default options.
  • Adjust the “neo Rename” settings to your individual requirements.

Compatibility and Requirements

Minimum system requirements for the Renamer plugin

  • WordPress version 6.2 to 6.9
  • PHP version 8.0 or higher
  • MySQL version 8.0 or higher
  • Optimized for servers running Linux (not Windows)
  • Server memory limit: min. 128 MB

Compatible plugins and tools with neo Rename

The neo Rename plugin has been tested with: Bricks, Elementor, Divi, Beaver, Oxygen, Breakdance, Gutenberg, WP Fastest Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, WP-Optimize, Autoptimize, Breeze, Cache Enabler

Legal notice about the Renamer plugin

The neo Rename plugin is provided free of charge and without warranty under the “GPLv2 or later” license. Use is at your own risk; liability for damages is excluded. Users outside Germany are responsible for complying with local regulations. This plugin may process personal data to the extent necessary for, for example, licensing, updates and secure operation.
You can find details in the full privacy policy.
sections.faq:
Features of neo Rename

Which features are included in the plugin?

The main features of the Renamer plugin are:

  • ✅ Optimize your SEO with descriptive image names 🎉
  • ✅ Reliable renaming of filename, title, and slug
  • ✅ Batch processing to change multiple filenames at once
  • ✅ Instant preview of changes between old and new names
  • ✅ Undo renames
  • ✅ Fast, automatic update of image URLs in all posts
  • ✅ Supports all file formats, including videos and PDFs
  • ✅ SEO-friendly redirect to the new image URL 👑
  • ✅ Generate missing alt texts from image titles for SEO 👑
  • ✅ Remove year/month folders from the image path 👑
  • ✅ Search, replace, and filter with regex and advanced tools 👑

Short and to the point

What is neoRename?

The plugin neoRename is a WordPress plugin that lets you efficiently rename images, videos and other media files in your media library. It automatically updates all references in the database to update existing links and improve your SEO ranking.

SEO benefits?

What benefits does neoRename offer for SEO?

The plugin neoRename optimizes image titles, filenames and slugs, creates SEO-friendly redirects (301 redirects), and can automatically generate missing alt texts from image titles. This sustainably improves your site’s visibility in search engines.

Bulk renaming?

Can I rename multiple files at once?

Yes, with the built-in bulk or batch processing you can rename multiple files at once with neoRename. A preview function shows you all planned changes beforehand.

Supported formats?

Which file formats can I rename?

All common media formats are supported by neoRename for images, videos and documents, including: JPG, PNG, WEBP, SVG, PDF, MP4, MOV, MP3, ZIP and many more.

Redirects & references?

What happens to my existing image URLs after renaming?

When renaming, neoRename automatically updates all references in your WordPress database, including post content, ACF fields and even PHP arrays. Additionally, a 301 redirect ensures that the old image links already indexed by Google remain accessible. This keeps your SEO performance stable and you don’t lose rankings due to broken links.

Before renaming

What should I consider before renaming?

Renaming files in WordPress can affect existing image references and links. Before renaming media we recommend:

✅ Make a backup: Create a backup of your site before renaming many files at once.

✅ Start with single files: Test renaming with neoRename on single files first.

🛠️ Clear plugin cache: If problems occur after renaming, it can help to clear the plugin cache, as old image references may still be stored there.

🛠️ Clear browser cache: If incorrect or old images still appear, clearing the browser cache can update stale references.

🔙 Use the undo function: With one click you can undo changes in neoRename if something isn’t right.

🧠 SEO tip: By redirecting old URLs with neoRename you avoid negative effects on your Google ranking!

Undo?

Can I undo renames?

Yes, the neoRename plugin includes an undo function that can restore the previous filenames, titles and slugs after renaming.

WooCommerce?

Is neoRename compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, neoRename works smoothly with WooCommerce and detects all image and media references in product pages, galleries and descriptions.

Neo universe

What is the neoUniverse?

The neoUniverse is more than just a plugin collection. It’s your complete toolbox for all media challenges in WordPress. It currently includes ten specialized plugins: neoLibrary, neoRename, neoReplace, neoDuplicate, neoOptimize, neoLazy, neoDraw, neoAnimate and neoMotion. They work seamlessly together, are perfectly matched and cover all areas around media management, SEO and performance. Whether renaming images, replacing files, optimizing SEO, enabling lazy load or drawing and animating content. The neoUniverse makes your media workflow noticeably easier and more efficient. And the best part: the neoUniverse is continuously expanding. New tools and features make your WordPress everyday life even better.

Download with Safari

Why do I only see a folder when downloading?

If you’re using Safari, your Mac may automatically unzip the ZIP file. Instead of the ZIP file you then only get the unzipped folder. You can’t upload this folder directly to WordPress.

Solution: Open Safari Preferences and disable the option ”Open safe files after downloading”. After that the ZIP file remains as you need it.

Details are shown in the video titled ”How to disable Safari auto extract for ZIP files when downloading WordPress plugins” on YouTube.

More questions

I have more questions. Can you help me?

Sure! You can ask us your questions at any time via our support page. We’ll reply shortly.
